position_sizing_evidence.raw_source_text: The Turtles used a volatility-based constant percentage risk position sizing algorithm. N is the 20-day exponential moving average of True Range. Units were sized so that 1 N represented 1% of account equity. Unit = 1% of Account Equity divided by N Dollars per Point. The Turtles also limited the number of Units that could be maintained at different risk levels: 4 Units for a single market, 6 Units for closely correlated markets, 10 Units for loosely correlated markets, and 12 Units for total single-direction exposure.
position_sizing_evidence.captured_position_rule: Position size is volatility-adjusted using N so that one Unit represents approximately 1% of account equity at one N of volatility; Unit size = 1% of account equity / N dollar volatility, with portfolio/unit exposure limits applied.

sizing_parameters.N_definition: 20-day exponential moving average of True Range
